import narwhals as nw

# Example DataFrame
df = nw.from_dict({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [95.5, 87.3, 92.8]
})

# Convert columns: user_id to Int32, score to Float32
df_converted = df.with_columns(
    user_id=nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    score=nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
)

print(df_converted)
print(df_converted.schema)
